The 30 drawings cover six subsystems:

| Subsystem | Drawings | Count |
|---|---|---:|
| Box / enclosure | D-001–D-005 | 5 |
| Powder handling | D-006–D-010 | 5 |
| Recoater | D-011–D-015 | 5 |
| Optics | D-016–D-020 | 5 |
| Gas flow | D-021–D-022 | 2 |
| Build-plate / Z-axis assembly | D-023–D-030 | 8 |

The final two drawings, for the Z-axis bottom plate and motor plate, are grouped with the build-plate subsystem.

The BOM has two relevant groups: the **explicit Z-axis parts** in *SensorGantry*, and the *Build-plate* parts that make up or support the moving build platform.

**Explicitly named Z-axis BOM rows (SensorGantry):**
- Z axis linear rod
- Z axis stepper bracket
- Z axis linear stepper
- Z axis guide clamp
- Z axis linear guide

**Build-platform / Z-lift assembly rows (Build-plate):**
- Build base
- Build cylinder
- Build cylinder clamp ring
- Build Plate
- Motor plate
- Motor plate shaft
- NEMA 23 Tr11x2 Non-Captive
- Self-centering keyless bushing
- Heating element plate

**Drawings for corresponding parts:**
- **D-023 — BuildCylinder** → Build cylinder
- **D-024 — ByggeBase** → Build base
- **D-026 — Build Plate** → Build Plate
- **D-027 — Cylinder Spænd Ring** → Build cylinder clamp ring
- **D-028 — VarmeElementPlade** → Heating element plate
- **D-030 — Z-axis MotorPlate** → appears to correspond to the BOM’s Motor plate

There is also **D-029 — Z-axis BottomPlate**, but the BOM does not show an obvious row with that exact name. The SensorGantry Z-axis rows do not have drawing files identified for them in the BOM.

The recoater is made up of these fabricated parts shown or referenced by its drawings:

- **Recoater wall** and **end-stop bracket** — support the assembly and its travel limit.
- **Recoater stage plate** — mounts to the linear bearings.
- **Recoater mount block** — connects the stage plate to the arm.
- **Recoater arm** — carries the recoater head.
- **Recoater head/adjusting plate** and **clamp** — hold and adjust the blade.
- **Silicone wiper blade** — the 1 mm sheet used to spread powder.

The associated motion hardware listed for the recoater includes two linear rods and bushings, shaft supports, a NEMA 23 stepper with driver, timing pulley and belt, and the idler assembly.
Drawing **D-014 (RecoaterStagePlate.pdf)** documents the recoater stage plate.
Drawing D-010 documents the BOM row **“Powder stepper bracket.”**
The BOM’s **Motor plate** corresponds to drawing **D-030**, labeled “Z-axis MotorPlate.” D-029 is the Z-axis BottomPlate.

**Partly.** The BOM lists a front and a back door, both aluminium; drawing D‑001 specifies **two 3 mm aluminium doors**, so the material and quantity agree.

The Left Side Box interfaces with the Print Platform, Top Side, Front Side Box, and Back Box.
The **Left Side Box, Back Box, Front Side Box, and Right Box** connect to the print platform, according to the BOM’s interface listings.
The cylinder clamp ring attaches the build cylinder to the build platform. It also locates and holds the Z-axis motor assembly, including the build-base linear stage.
The 1 mm silicone wiper is held by an aluminium **Recoater Clamp**, which clamps it to the recoater head. The wiper drawing shows eight Ø3.4 mm through-holes for fastening.

The BOM lists the 24 V, 20 A power supply as an **Omron S8VK-C48024**, supplied by **RS Components** (order code **786-6462**). It doesn’t name another supplier; the model number can help you look for other sellers.
No. The BOM lists **Max Photonics** as the supplier for the MFSC-300W laser source; it does not identify a second source.
DTU could make it—the BOM lists the recoater mount block as a custom part supplied by DTU. Its drawing specifies aluminium (EN AW 5005).
The BOM lists Misumi as the supplier for the dispenser drum coupling (SCOC20-6-8). It doesn’t identify any other sellers.

The cylinder clamp ring is a separate retaining and locating part. Its stated purpose is to clamp the build cylinder to the build platform and locate and hold the build-base linear-stage assembly. The build cylinder itself is the aluminium tube (listed as Ø280 mm OD, Ø252 mm ID); the ring is not the cylinder.

The recoater arm is **not mechanically connected to the build plate**. It is attached through the recoater mount block to the recoater stage plate, which rides on the linear bearings/rods supported by the recoater wall. The recoater head and silicone wiper attach to the arm; the wiper sweeps across the build plate during recoating.

The documents identify a few connections explicitly and imply others through part descriptions. The clearest subsystem bridge is the **Print Platform**.

| Subsystems connected | Connecting parts or relationship |
|---|---|
| **Box ↔ build-plate / Z-axis** | The **Print Platform** is the structural interface. The build-plate assembly sits at the platform opening; its build-cylinder clamp ring holds the build-base/Z-axis assembly. |
| **Box ↔ recoater** | The **Print Platform** is one of the recoater’s stated interfaces. The **Recoater Wall** carries the linear stage, and the stage plate, mount block, arm, and blade form the recoater assembly. |
| **Recoater ↔ powder handling** | The Print Platform description says powder handling connects **via the recoater**. The recoater spreads powder; the powder hopper, roller, housing, and related powder parts serve that handling path. |
| **Gas flow ↔ build chamber / platform** | Shielding-gas cross-flow emerges from the **Print Platform**. The **process-chamber inlet** can screw into the platform or pass through a side wall; the inlet geometry, end duct, tubing, blower, and outlet ducting complete the gas path. |
| **Box ↔ optics** | The **Galvo Box Bracket** attaches the galvo/collimator to the top box plate. The **Sunny Galvo Adapter Plate** joins the galvo and collimator; the support brackets carry the galvo assembly. The laser source’s BOM interface is listed as **GLAMS**. |
| **Box ↔ box panels and doors** | The BOM explicitly lists panel interfaces: the **Left Side Box**, **Back Box**, **Top Side**, **Front Side Box**, and **Right Box** join the enclosure. The **Front Door** meets the Front Side Box through the hinges and latches. |
| **Electrical ↔ motion, heating, gas, and powder equipment** | These are functional control connections rather than listed mechanical interfaces: stepper drivers connect to the recoater, build-plate, and powder motors; PID/SSR parts control the build-plate heaters; solenoid valves and the oxygen sensor belong to gas control. |

The BOM’s **“Interface with”** column is populated mainly for the enclosure panels and front-door hardware. Other links above come from stated design intent or part function, so the documents do not specify every mounting or wiring connection in detail.
